sections.title: SB04, W3L8 GANs as classifier-guided generative sampler

keyTerms.definition: The discriminator: D/(1-D*) = p_data/p_g.

recall.question: What does classifier-guided mean?
recall.answer: The generator's training signal is the discriminator's gradient; the discriminator is a density-ratio estimator pointing G toward data regions.
